config.record_grain: one row per ASIC business-name registration record, including currently registered names and recent deregistered names

fields.evidence: Help File PDF p.3 sample header BN_NAME; p.8 data dictionary: BN_NAME is the business name as it appears on ASIC's Business Names register. Discovery sample row 2 contains '   Plumbing Gas and Solar', supporting trim only.

Help File PDF p.8: BN_STATUS is Registration Status for the Business Name; permitted values are Registered and Cancelled, with cancellation meaning the registered business name ceases to exist. Discovery samples show Registered.

Help File PDF p.9: BN_ABN is the Australian Business Number and suppressed ABNs are NULL; p.3 sample header includes BN_ABN. Discovery samples show 11-digit numeric strings such as 30947976159. The abn operation performs validation; no ACN is inferred.

unmapped_fields.reason: Register label ('BUSINESS NAMES'), not a legal entity name, trading name, identifier, or supported canonical field.
This is the business-name registration date, not a legal entity registration date; explicitly not mapped to entity.date_registered.
This is the business-name cancellation date. The ontology subset has no business-name valid-to/cancellation field, and it must not be used as legal entity deregistration.
Former state-regulator business-name identifier; no supported canonical field for this identifier.
Previous state of registration for the former business-name regulator; no supported address or canonical field is justified.

limitations: This is a business-name register snapshot, not a company/legal-entity register; BN_NAME is retained as a trading/business-name label and does not establish a legal name or holder type.
BN_ABN may be suppressed, absent, associated with multiple business names, or not identify the legal holder uniquely; only checksum-valid ABNs emit observations.
BN_STATUS describes the business-name registration, not necessarily the legal entity's status. Cancelled must not be interpreted as entity deregistration.
BN_REG_DT and BN_CANCEL_DT are deliberately unmapped because they describe the business name rather than the legal entity.
The source envelope supplies the publication timestamp and licence; this mapping uses the publication timestamp as the observation-time proxy.
All authority and field-confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
